Ниацинамид.about: Niacinamide (B3): reduces the risk of non-melanoma skin cancer in those with a history of it (RR 0.50, MA 2022); topically - for hyperpigmentation; the effect has not been described in healthy people.
Ниацинамид.caution: Increased risk of GI symptoms (MA 2022); topical forms are better tolerated; not to be confused with niacin.
Ниацинамид.course: Prevention is still relevant (according to RCT schemes from MA 2022); Topically - in courses.
Ниацинамид.food_sources: Meat, poultry, fish, liver, peanuts; nutritional status is not detailed in abstracts.
Ниацинамид.guidelines: MA 2022 (29 trials, n=3039): nicotinamide - skin cancer RR 0.50 [0.29-0.85], weak recommendation; reviews 2022/2025: topical niacinamide among treatments for PIH.
Ниацинамид.how_to_choose: Orally - only as prescribed by a doctor if you have a history of skin cancer; topical - niacinamide agents for pigmentation; not to be confused with niacin (flushing).
mechs: prevention of non-melanoma skin cancer (RR 0.50, MA 2022)
lightening of spots, high quality research
reduction of pigmentation along with lasers and other means
Ниацинамид.myths: “Lipid data - about niacin” - does not apply to nicotinamide. “Nicotinamide is harmless” - there are GI AEs (MA 2022). “Everyone needs it for their skin” - proven for groups at risk of skin cancer and hyperpigmentation.
Ниацинамид.name: Niacinamide
Ниацинамид.onset: Chemoprophylaxis - in a course while taking it; in MA 2022, the effect on skin cancer and actinic keratoses is significant, GI AEs are noted.
Ниацинамид.title: Niacinamide
Ниацинамид.who_needs: Individuals with cancer or ≥1 skin cancer—chemoprophylaxis (weak GRADE recommendation); topically - for hyperpigmentation; There is no data for “everyone has energy”.
